lines.text: Every breakout starts in one place: a single pore. Let's go inside.
lines.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi bɹˈeɪkaʊt stˈɑːɹts ɪn wˈʌn plˈeɪs: ɐ sˈɪŋɡəl pˈɔːɹ. lˈɛts ɡˌoʊ ɪnsˈaɪd.

lines.text: This is a healthy pore. A hair, an oil gland at its base, and oil flowing up and out onto your skin. As long as the oil keeps moving, the pore stays clear.
lines.phonemes: ðɪs ɪz ɐ hˈɛlθi pˈɔːɹ. ɐ hˈɛɹ, ɐn ˈɔɪl ɡlˈænd æɾ ɪts bˈeɪs, ænd ˈɔɪl flˈoʊɪŋ ˌʌp ænd ˈaʊt ˌɑːntʊ jʊɹ skˈɪn. æz lˈɔŋ æz ðɪ ˈɔɪl kˈiːps mˈuːvɪŋ, ðə pˈɔːɹ stˈeɪz klˈɪɹ.

lines.text: Now add dead skin cells. They mix with the oil and pack the pore shut. Open to the air, the plug oxidizes dark: a blackhead. Closed over by skin, it stays pale: a whitehead.
lines.phonemes: nˈaʊ ˈæd dˈɛd skˈɪn sˈɛlz. ðeɪ mˈɪks wɪððɪ ˈɔɪl ænd pˈæk ðə pˈɔːɹ ʃˈʌt. ˈoʊpən tə ðɪ ˈɛɹ, ðə plˈʌɡ ˈɑːksɪdˌaɪzᵻz dˈɑːɹk: ɐ blˈækhɛd. klˈoʊzd ˌoʊvɚ baɪ skˈɪn, ɪt stˈeɪz pˈeɪl: ɐ wˈaɪthɛd.

lines.text: Trapped oil is food. Bacteria feed on it, and the wall swells red: a papule. Then, a pustule.
lines.phonemes: tɹˈæpt ˈɔɪl ɪz fˈuːd. bæktˈɪɹiə fˈiːd ˈɔn ɪt, ænd ðə wˈɔːl swˈɛlz ɹˈɛd: ɐ pˈæpjuːl. ðˈɛn, ɐ pˈʌstʃəl.

lines.text: So how does it clear? Mandelic acid keeps the pore clear. Benzoyl peroxide clears the bacteria.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ hˌaʊ dˈʌz ɪt klˈɪɹ? mændˈɛlɪk ˈæsɪd kˈiːps ðə pˈɔːɹ klˈɪɹ. bˈɛnzɔɪl pəɹˈɑːksaɪd klˈɪɹz ðə bæktˈɪɹiə.

lines.text: Then give it time. Judge it at eight to twelve weeks.
lines.phonemes: ðˈɛn ɡˈɪv ɪt tˈaɪm. dʒˈʌdʒ ɪɾ æɾ ˈeɪt tə twˈɛlv wˈiːks.
